title: The first attempt
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the old generator room in the base of the lighthouse: a riveted iron backup generator, a switchboard of brass levers and gauges, cables and an iron gate. Time and weather: night, renewed storm, slate-blue darkness pierced by crimson drone optics and emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important.
Camera: medium on the generator as Penny throws the lever; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny throws the start lever; the generator sputters, rattles and almost catches — then cuts out with a sad wheeze, and the room falls dark again.
No dialogue.
Sound: lever clunk, sputtering engine, wheeze, silence.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, Tomkin), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: Penny groans and grips the lever.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: lever clunk, sputtering engine, wheeze, silence.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
